why.heading: Why landscaping ads need a seasonal plan
why.intro: A flat monthly budget spends the same in a slow month as in a packed one. We give each channel one job and move spend with your calendar.

cards.title: Workforce swings by season
cards.body: US private employment in landscaping services ran about 34% higher in July 2024 than in January 2024. That's workers, not leads, but it shows the workforce swing within a year.

cards.title: Search catches people looking
cards.body: Google Search Ads and Local Services Ads reach homeowners already looking for a lawn or landscape company, which is the shorter path to a booked job.

cards.title: Facebook keeps you remembered
cards.body: Between searches, Facebook and Instagram show your finished yards to homeowners in your area and bring back site visitors who didn't call.

cards.title: Local Services Ads
cards.body: Pay-per-lead ads above the map, managed on signals Google names, including rating, review count and response time.

cards.title: Google Search Ads
cards.body: One ad group per service, phrase match and a weekly-growing negative list, aimed at retaining walls, walkways and other installs you want more of.

cards.title: Landscaping Facebook ads
cards.body: Before-and-after yard video, seasonal lawn offers, and design consultation offers for hardscape buyers. Retargeting runs before any cold audience spend.

cards.title: Crew recruiting ads
cards.body: Hiring campaigns on Meta reach crew members who are working, not browsing job boards, on a budget kept apart from lead generation.

cards.title: Tracking and offline conversions
cards.body: Conversion actions count real leads. With Housecall Pro, completed jobs and revenue can feed back to Google Ads so bidding learns from booked work.

pricing.heading: Packages for landscaping advertising
pricing.subhead: Your ad spend goes straight to Google and Meta. For landscaping ads, paid media management is included from Growth up, and Organic SEO from Foundation up.

faqs.question: Can my landscaping company run Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: When we checked in October 2026, Google's US list had categories for landscaping, lawn care, tree services and snow removal. Google screens each business before its ads go live. After that, reviews and response time feed your ranking.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for lawn care companies?
faqs.answer: For the right offer, yes. Seasonal lawn offers and before-and-after project video suit Meta. Asking strangers to book a service call cold rarely works in the trades, so we start with people who already visited your site.

faqs.question: Should I start with Google or Facebook?
faqs.answer: Google, in almost every case, because it reaches people who are searching right now. Facebook then keeps your company familiar between searches.

faqs.question: How much should I spend on landscaping ads?
faqs.answer: Start from what a customer is worth. A weekly mowing customer can be worth a whole season of visits, which changes what you can pay to win them. Spend goes to the platforms directly.

faqs.question: What happens to my ads in winter?
faqs.answer: Spend drops when your lawn work slows, unless you sell snow removal, in which case budget moves there. Your account and its history stay in your name year-round.

cta.heading: Make next season's ad budget count
cta.body: Book a call and we'll read your Google, LSA and Facebook accounts with you: settings, search terms, where spend went and what tracking counts.
